subject: Invoice intake: proposed path change and sample rows + ack rules
messages:
From: Simon Patel <simon.patel@northbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@northbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice intake — channel change request

Hi Stephanie,

We're preparing to move Northbridge's invoice submission over to Redwood's portal as part of our supplier consolidation. A couple of quick questions before we start the migration:

1) Does Redwood require PO stamping on the invoice PDF itself, or is a PO reference in the email/subject token sufficient for automated matching?
2) If we keep email as a fallback, what is the minimal subject token format you need? We've used formats like "PO:12345" and "PO#12345" — which will work for your parser?
3) Please send an exemplar of the minimal CSV/rows you consume for multi-line invoices (we sometimes send multiple PO lines in a single invoice).
4) Any required ACK header or acks we should expect after submission?

We can target a go-live next Monday (6/1) if the mapping is straightforward. Attaching a sample CSV from our AP team for reference — can you confirm whether the columns align?

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Patel
Head of Finance Operations
Northbridge Logistics

Attachment: multipo-sample-lines.csv (CSV, 2KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Simon Patel <simon.patel@northbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice intake — channel change request

Hi Simon — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and a checklist below so your AP can move forward:

- PO stamping: not strictly required on the PDF if the invoice includes an exact PO reference in the subject token or in the invoice body (line-level PO references preferred for multi-PO invoices).
- Subject token: please use the exact token format PO=<PO_NUMBER> (example: "PO=12345"). This is what our subject parser is currently configured to extract reliably. Variants like PO:12345 sometimes fail when vendors include extra punctuation.
- Multi-PO invoices: we accept multiple line rows. Provide each line as a separate row with a PO column and LineAmount/Quantity columns.
- ACKs: portal submissions get immediate 200-style acknowledgement in the UI and an email ack (subject: "Redwood — Invoice received: <supplier> — <token>"). For SMTP/email fallback we send an automated receipt email within 30 minutes if the subject token is correct.

Checklist / sample rows (attach template in XLSX):

Columns we require (minimal):
- supplier_name, supplier_tax_id, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO, PO_line, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, currency, entity_code

Example CSV row (single-line invoice):
"Northbridge Logistics","98-7654321","INV-2026-017","2026-05-15","12345","1","Consulting retainer","1","5000.00","5000.00","USD","US-01"

Example multi-line (3-line excerpt):
"Northbridge Logistics",...,"INV-2026-020","2026-05-18","12345","1","Design work","10","150.00","1500.00","USD","US-01"
"Northbridge Logistics",...,"INV-2026-020","2026-05-18","67890","1","License fee","1","2000.00","2000.00","USD","US-02"

Attached: northbridge-invoice-template-v2.xlsx (XLSX template with the columns above) — grab the template and return a small sample CSV with real-ish values so Ops can validate mapping.

Next steps / timeline:
- Simon: return one sample CSV (multipo-sample-lines.csv you already attached is fine) with PO values and entity_code populated.
- Vanessa (cc'd): we'll run a quick mapping validation in the sandbox and confirm by 5/19 EOD.
- If mapping looks good, we enable portal for Northbridge and keep email as a monitored fallback for 30 days.

If you need us to accept PO in-body only (no subject token), we can but need to set an initial manual review for the first 10 invoices.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Vendor Onboarding & Billing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: northbridge-invoice-template-v2.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

Thanks Stephanie — that clarifies a lot. A couple quick follow-ups:

- Multiple POs per invoice: yes, we will include separate PO values per row. Will Redwood support different entity_code values on different rows (we need to bill multiple Redwood entities sometimes)?
- VAT / tax rows: do you need separate tax lines or a single total tax column per invoice line?
- For the subject token we will standardize to PO=XXXXX. Will you also accept a PO field in the CSV (you said yes) — just confirming both are fine.

I've attached a slightly expanded sample CSV from our AP so you can see entity_code and tax columns. If we can get Ops to confirm mapping by EOD tomorrow we can still hit 6/1 target.

Thanks,
Simon

Attachment: multipo-sample-lines.csv (CSV, 3KB)

Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Northbridge go-live decision / email fallback policy

Vanessa / Jordan — quick internal note after Simon's sample and our sandbox run:

- Mapping: their multipo-sample-lines.csv maps cleanly to our columns except for an extra VAT_type column. Ops can populate a single tax_amount column from VAT_type + tax_rate; no blocker.
- Multiple entities per invoice: supported (entity_code per row). Confirmed in sandbox.
- Policy: enable portal as primary channel. Allow email fallback for 30 days with these constraints: subject token must be present ("PO=<number>") OR the invoice must contain a top-line PO field. If neither present, route to manual review queue.
- ACK SLA: email fallback receives an automated receipt within 30 minutes; escalate to Ops only if not acked in 90 minutes.

Action items:
- Vanessa: schedule mapping job in sandbox and run batch of 5 sample invoices from Simon; confirm by EOD Monday 5/24.
- Jordan: update the supplier onboarding doc with the subject token example and the 30-day email fallback policy. I will draft the customer-facing note to Simon after you update the doc.

If both items green-lighted, we'll plan a soft go-live 6/1 with monitored support window (Mon-Fri 9–5 PT) for the first week.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Vendor Onboarding & Billing
Redwood Inference
